subject: prd/docgate
statement: If an operation is invalid (dangling target, double-supersede, ID reuse, schema-violating payload), then docgate shall abort with a defect naming file, op, reason, and remedy — as human text on stderr and as one machine-readable JSON line per defect on a `--defects-json` stream.
rationale: fail closed; authors fix fast; CI annotates precisely
fit_criterion: 100% of fixture defect cases produce the named quadruple in both forms; JSON parses against the defect-schema golden; zero best-effort output
